finding: The enabled WoW64 converter clears IsolationPrefix before storing IsolationEnabled. A flag-store fault leaves NULL; a later prefix-copy fault can retain a non-NULL pointer.
evidence: Native enabled x86 role24 retains00000000; roles43-45 retain the rebased pointer before their prefix-copy fault.
correction: Null pointer store, flag store, pointer publication, bounded UTF-16 copy. Normalize proven native pointer bytes even for a later copy failure.
raw-native-inputs: unchanged; the earlier normalizer only handled successful queries and failed to relocate already-published pointers on a later fault.
